dct_description_sm: Although the development of Climate Change Adaptation Plans is critical to the resilience of Northwest Territories (NWT) Communities, it is more important and more efficient that communities put on the climate change lens for all decisions that they make. This requires a paradigm shift in the considerations that are applied to all planning and decision making. Many of the currently available tools (such as adaptation plans) are scattered, highly technical and designed for southern communities and the climate change considerations for the North are unique. This project proposed to develop a guide to assist communities in the North to align and embed climate change adaptation into all of their existing plans and those that they may develop in the future.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Community mobilization

dct_title_s: Integrating Climate Change Measures into all Municipal Planning and Decision Making: A Guide for Northern Communities
